fundamentals.name: Airbnb, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Strong growth and profitability metrics are supported by a solid balance sheet and free cash flow, though valuation multiples are on the higher side.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimates; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 17.9% YoY and analyst estimates for 25.2% FY growth indicate strong top-line expansion.
Profit margin of 19.9% and Return on Equity of 32.3% demonstrate high profitability.
Free cash flow of $3.19B TTM and substantial total cash of $12.01B provide financial flexibility.
Forward P/E of 22.42x is significantly lower than trailing P/E of 33.47x, suggesting expected earnings growth.
Analyst consensus is a strong buy with a mean target price of $156.51.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 33.47x and Price/Sales of 6.36x indicate a premium valuation.
Operating margin of 3.2% is relatively low despite high gross margins.
Quarterly earnings growth was only 3.9% and the last reported quarter missed EPS estimates.
Quick ratio of 0.74 suggests potential short-term liquidity constraints.

news.paragraph: Airbnb Inc. (ABNB) has seen its stock price rise recently, outperforming the market and attracting investor attention. One report highlights the stock's GF Value at $169.73, suggesting it may be undervalued relative to its current price. The company is also noted as a significant holding in Jeff Bezos's portfolio, further underscoring investor interest.
